service.description: A draft RFQ (RqtPurchaseRfq) of one of the user's organizations, filed by the user: the organization as its OrgInternal RequestParty, its name, specification text, delivery facility, currency (the buying policy's, else the accounting one) and response date (the buying policy's rfqResponseDays from now by default). Given approved purchase request lines (sourceRequestItemKeys, requestId:requestItemSeqId), each becomes an item for the quantity left to source, linked to its line by RequestItemAssoc. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses an organization outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), another organization's facility (FACILITY_INVALID), an unknown currency (CURRENCY_INVALID), and a source line of another organization (SOURCE_INVALID), not approved (NOT_APPROVED) or already sourced (ALREADY_SOURCED).

An open RFQ's name, specification text, response date, facility and currency (the currency only while no quote is proposed, CURRENCY_CHANGE_QUOTED). A change of the response date, text, facility or currency is a new revision, which the suppliers are sent again; it is audit-logged here (the RFQ's only, F-P11-11), a first value set included, and an as-of print reads it. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED) and the refusals of create#QuoteRequest.

An item of an open RFQ, new, changed or removed (remove: cancelled, so the change stays in its history): a product usable for buying (check#ProductUsable, usage Purchase; PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE) or a description, the quantity and its unit (the product's by default), the required date. Each change is the RFQ's new revision, which the suppliers are sent again; a quote still requested follows it (its line added, changed or taken off), one the supplier answered keeps its lines. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED), an item not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), one with neither product nor description (ITEM_INVALID), an unknown product or unit (PRODUCT_REQUIRED, UOM_INVALID) and a quantity that is not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID).

A supplier invited to an open RFQ: its quote, a purchase order with one part (the supplier the vendor, the organization the customer, the RFQ's currency and facility) in OrderRequested ("Request Quote"), a line per item linked by RequestItemOrder, unpriced until the supplier answers; a supplier already invited answers its quote (existing). With declined, a requested quote the supplier declined (OrderRejected, "Reject Request", with its reason). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED), an RFQ with no items (NO_ITEMS), another organization's supplier (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE), the buying policy's Stop (SUPPLIER_BLOCKED, SUPPLIER_SUSPENDED, SUPPLIER_UNAPPROVED; a Warn is a warning), and for a decline a quote not of the RFQ (INVITATION_UNAVAILABLE), one already answered (QUOTE_PROPOSED) or no reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

An RFQ's print as published now, or as of a date and time read back from the audit log (its items' product, quantity, unit, required date, description and cancel; its response date and text). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, PURCHASE_APPROVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_APPROVE; refuses an RFQ outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a time to come or not a time (DATE_INVALID) and one before the RFQ (REQUEST_NOT_YET).

An open RFQ published and sent to its invited suppliers: the RFQ as of now rendered to a PDF, stored once per print as RequestContent (RqCntRfqPublished) stamped with its time, and mailed with the PDF to each quote still requested or proposed (orderIds, else those not sent the current revision; a material change after a send needs a new send) at the supplier's order addresses, else its primary ones, one message per address in its own transaction, recorded as the quote's OrderEmailMessage. A supplier with no address, an invalid one or no delivery is InvitationDeliveryFailed with its code (RECIPIENT_REQUIRED, RECIPIENT_INVALID, DELIVERY_FAILED) and the others are sent. The first send moves a draft to Submitted (published). The same operation key answers the first result. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED), no items (NO_ITEMS), no invitation (NO_INVITATIONS), a quote not invited to it (INVITATION_UNAVAILABLE) and a key used for another request (OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT).

parameter.name: orderIds
parameter.description: The quotes to send (a comma list or list); empty sends those not sent the current revision

parameter.name: supplierResults
parameter.description: Each quote's orderId, supplierPartyId, supplierName, recipients, resultStatus (SENT or InvitationDeliveryFailed), errorCode and errorMessage.

service.description: A supplier's quote entered on its behalf: the supplier's reference (otherPartyOrderId) and quote date, validity (validFromDate, validThruDate), payment term and Incoterm, delivery date, the channel it came by (salesChannelEnumId: e-mail, phone and the others) and its evidence (a file, or how it came) as OrderContent (OctSupplierQuote) in the supplier's role. A requested quote moves to OrderProposed ("Propose Quote"); with no orderId a new quote is entered straight in OrderProposed, from the vendor for the organization, with the RFQ's items when requestId is given (one supplier, one live quote per RFQ: QUOTE_EXISTS). Each change of the part's fields is audit-logged with the reason. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses an order that is not a requested or proposed quote (QUOTE_CLOSED), outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another organization's or a stopped supplier, an unknown currency, term or channel (CURRENCY_INVALID, TERM_INVALID, CHANNEL_INVALID) and a validity that ends before it starts (DATE_INVALID).

A requested or proposed quote's line: the quoted unit price, quantity, unit, promised date, the supplier's item code (otherPartyProductId) and text, each change audit-logged with the reason (the line's history); with no orderItemSeqId a new line of a product usable for buying. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses an order that is not a requested or proposed quote (QUOTE_CLOSED), a line not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), an unknown product or unit and a negative price or quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID).

A proposed (or awarded: placed from OrderProposed) quote line's price, or a quantity tier of it (minQuantity, price), made an effective purchase price of the supplier for the buying organization (R-PUR-21; Products §7): written through mantle.product.PriceServices.store#ProductPrice, valid for the quote's validity (from now at the earliest, to the quote's thru date at the latest, or the dates given within it), naming the source quote and line (sourceOrderId, sourceOrderItemSeqId). A price of the same supplier, product, organization, currency and tier in effect is ended where the new one starts (expire#ProductPrice); a store's, an agreement's or a per-term row is left alone. Requires SUPPLIER_PRICE_EDIT only (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a quote outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not proposed (QUOTE_NOT_PROPOSED) or expired (QUOTE_EXPIRED), a line not on it or with no product (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, PRODUCT_REQUIRED), no price (PRICE_REQUIRED), dates that end before they start (DATE_INVALID) and a price of the tier starting later (PRICE_OVERLAP).
